sources.title: GitHub - mir8077faiyaz/Distilling-Hate: Official Repo of Distilling-Hate
sources.snippet: Hate speech detection systems carry significant societal risks, including false positives that may disproportionately affect marginalized groups. We intentionally avoid naive data-level oversampling and instead rely on loss-aware training and knowledge distillation to better reflect real-world data distributions.

sources.title: hugsanaa/DeepSeek-Distill-Multiclass-HateSpeech · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: DeepSeek-Distill-Multiclass-Hate-Speech DeepSeek-Distill-Multiclass-Hate-Speech is a distilled large-scale language model specialized in analyzing social media content related to hate speech categories. The base model provides a strong contextual representation learning, which improves performance on hate speech detection.
